# CS-002: A bouncer is registered and pulling decisions

- **Group:** CrowdSec and fail2ban
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** the full result needs `sudo`. Without root this check may report `unknown`; it never reports a pass it could not verify.

## Why it matters

CrowdSec only decides; bouncers enforce. With no bouncer every detection bans nothing. A bouncer whose last pull is older than five minutes has lost the local API (often after a Docker network change) and enforces stale or no decisions. A bouncer that connects from several addresses (one per container or replica) shows up as its base name plus one name@IP row per address, all sharing the base row's API key; stackward treats them as one bouncer that is fresh when any row pulled recently. A stale base row next to fresh name@IP rows is normal: do not delete it, because every row that shares its key stops working.

## Verify by hand

```sh
sudo cscli bouncers list
```

## How to fix it

Install the bouncer that matches your ingress (proxy bouncer behind a tunnel, firewall bouncer for direct traffic), and check it can reach the local API. Never delete a stale base bouncer whose name@IP rows still pull: they share its API key.
